summary: Iter 41 verified: (1) sidebar Help link renders with correct role-aware href for both admin (IFPI_Admin_User_Guide.pdf) and learner (IFPI_Student_User_Guide.pdf), target=_blank, data-testid=sidebar-help-link present. (2) guide auto-rebuild works: touching STUDENT_USER_GUIDE.md causes the next GET to rebuild the PDF (mtime advanced), and a subsequent GET is idempotent (mtime unchanged). (3) anonymous /api/public/guides/*.pdf returns 200 application/pdf with %PDF magic. (4) /api/catalog contains 'IFPI Fundamentals' and no debris (Stripe Test/Ent Inspect/Entitlement Test/Paid E2E/TEST_/Nelson PLC). (5) services.test_debris_cleanup.tick(db, dry_run=True) runs cleanly and its stats include the new 'marketplace_optouts' key. (6) /catalog public page renders the fitness hero and only 'IFPI Fundamentals' cards (featured + all-courses). All 7 pytest cases pass; all frontend UI assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: guide_builder.ensure_fresh graceful degradation is correct: if a rebuild fails and a stale PDF exists, it still serves the stale PDF - good resilience.

test_debris_cleanup.tick returns stats dict with 'marketplace_optouts' key; TEST_ORG_SLUG_PATTERNS is scoped to slug prefixes only (factory-org-%, test-acad-% etc.) so real academies (e.g. IFPI Main Academy) can never be opted out - safe.

DashboardLayout renders href as '${backend}/api/public/guides/...' but observed href is relative '/api/public/guides/...' in the DOM (backend var likely empty in dev proxy). Still ends with the expected suffix so the assertion passes and the link works through ingress; consider whether that variable should always be present (minor).
test_credentials: UAT admin/learner used as specified. IFPI Fundamentals preserved (not modified).
